messages.text: I start my new job at FPT on Monday the 16th.
Ehh?! Monday already? Are you nervous?
A bit. My manager is called Huong, she seemed nice.
Then you'll be fine. Lay out your clothes on Sunday night.
Good idea. I'll take the 7:15 bus.
Ooh, an early bird now!

target: The user starts a new job at FPT on Monday the 16th and feels a bit nervous. Their manager is Huong, who seemed nice. The companion suggested laying out clothes on Sunday night, and the user plans to take the 7:15 bus.

messages.text: My cat Bơ has a vet visit on Thursday.
Mm... is he sick?
No, just his vaccine. It costs 350k.
That's good. Keep him calm in the carrier.
I'll bring his blanket.
That will help him.

target: The user's cat Bơ has a vet visit on Thursday for a vaccine that costs 350k; he is not sick. The companion advised keeping him calm in the carrier, and the user will bring his blanket.

messages.text: I failed my calculus midterm. 4 out of 10.
...Tch. That stings. What went wrong?
I ran out of time on the last two questions.
Then practise timed papers. Not more reading.
The final is on 12 December.
Plenty of time. Start this week.
Okay. I'll do one paper every Saturday.

target: The user failed their calculus midterm with 4 out of 10, because they ran out of time on the last two questions. The final is on 12 December. The companion suggested timed practice papers, and the user will do one every Saturday.

messages.text: I'm going to Da Lat with Trang and Vy next weekend.
Ooh! A trip with friends! What's the plan?
Strawberry farm, then the night market.
Bring a jacket! It gets cold there at night.
We booked a homestay for 2 nights.
Perfect! Send me the strawberry report after.

target: The user is going to Da Lat next weekend with Trang and Vy, with a strawberry farm and the night market planned and a homestay booked for 2 nights. The companion reminded them to bring a jacket for the cold nights.

messages.text: I've decided to quit sugar in my coffee.
Mm. Starting today?
From tomorrow. I drink about 3 cups a day.
Maybe go down slowly... half a spoon first.
Okay, half a spoon for a week.
That sounds kind to yourself.

target: The user decided to stop putting sugar in their coffee from tomorrow; they drink about 3 cups a day. The companion suggested going down slowly, and the user will use half a spoon for a week first.

messages.text: my brother Nam got into Hanoi University of Science and Technology!
Hmph. Smart family, then. Tell him well done.
He's studying mechanical engineering.
Good choice. Practical.
He moves into the dorm on 5 September.
Help him carry the boxes, at least.

target: The user's brother Nam got into Hanoi University of Science and Technology to study mechanical engineering, and he moves into the dorm on 5 September. The companion told the user to pass on its congratulations.

messages.text: I want to start running again.
Ooh! When did you stop?
About two years ago, after I hurt my knee.
Is the knee okay now?
The doctor said yes in March.
Then let's start slow! Maybe 2 km?
I was thinking 3 km, three times a week.
Hmm, 3 km is okay if you walk part of it.
Fine. Monday, Wednesday, Friday mornings.
Before work? That's brave!
I start at 9, so I'll run at 6:30.
Okay! I'll ask you on Wednesday how it went!

target: The user wants to start running again after stopping about two years ago because of a knee injury; a doctor said the knee was fine in March. They plan 3 km three times a week, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings at 6:30, before work at 9. The companion suggested walking part of the distance at first and said it would ask on Wednesday how it went.

messages.text: I need to choose between two apartments.
Mm. Tell me about them.
One is in Cau Giay, 6 million a month, 25 square meters.
And the other?
Long Bien, 4.5 million, 35 square meters, but far from work.
How far?
40 minutes by motorbike. Cau Giay is 10 minutes.
That's 60 minutes a day of difference.
Yeah. But Long Bien has a balcony.
Is the balcony worth an hour every day?
Maybe not. I think I'll take Cau Giay.
It sounds like you already knew.

target: The user is choosing between two apartments: one in Cau Giay for 6 million a month, 25 square meters and 10 minutes from work, and one in Long Bien for 4.5 million, 35 square meters with a balcony but 40 minutes away by motorbike. The companion pointed out the extra hour of travel a day, and the user decided to take Cau Giay.

messages.text: my grandma's 80th birthday is on Sunday
Ehh, eighty! Is there a party?
Yes, lunch at her house in Nam Dinh.
What are you bringing her?
I don't know yet. She likes orchids.
Ooh, an orchid then!
My mom says she has too many orchids already.
Hmm... a photo album of the family?
That's actually nice. I have photos from Tet.
Print them! Grandmas love printed photos!
I'll print 20 photos tomorrow.
She's going to cry happy tears, I bet.

target: The user's grandmother turns 80 on Sunday, with a lunch at her house in Nam Dinh. She likes orchids, but the user's mother says she has too many. The companion suggested a family photo album, and the user will print 20 photos from Tet tomorrow.

messages.text: Can you help me think about my thesis topic?
Mm. What are the options?
Option one is traffic prediction with graphs.
And two?
Two is detecting fake product reviews in Vietnamese.
Which one keeps you up at night, in a good way?
The reviews one, honestly.
Is there data for it?
My supervisor Dr. Long has 50,000 labelled reviews.
Then the data question is answered.
I'll email him on Friday.
That sounds settled, then.

target: The user is choosing a thesis topic between traffic prediction with graphs and detecting fake product reviews in Vietnamese, and prefers the reviews topic. Their supervisor, Dr. Long, has 50,000 labelled reviews. The user will email him on Friday.

messages.text: I'm trying to save money this month.
Hmph. How much?
3 million by the end of November.
What eats your money most?
Food delivery. Like 1.5 million last month.
Then cook. At least on weekdays.
I can cook rice and eggs and that's it.
That's a start. Add vegetables.
Okay, I'll cook Monday to Friday.
And delete the app for a month.
Deleting it is too much!
...Fine. Keep it, but no orders on weekdays.

target: The user wants to save 3 million by the end of November. Food delivery cost them about 1.5 million last month. The user will cook from Monday to Friday, and the companion asked them not to order delivery on weekdays; the user refused to delete the app.

messages.text: We had a fight, me and Linh.
Oh... what happened?
She forgot my birthday, and I said something mean.
That sounds painful for both of you.
We haven't talked for 3 days.
Do you want to talk to her again?
Yes. I miss her.
Maybe you could start with the mean thing you said?
Like, apologise first?
Mm... only for your part.
Okay. I'll call her tonight after 8.
I hope it goes gently.

target: The user and their friend Linh had a fight after Linh forgot the user's birthday and the user said something mean; they have not talked for 3 days. The user misses her, and the companion suggested apologising for their own part. The user will call her tonight after 8.

messages.text: I got the scholarship to study in Japan!
EHH?! Really?! Which one?
MEXT. For a master's at Tohoku University.
Tohoku! That's in Sendai, right?
Yes. I leave on 28 March.
That's so soon! Are you excited?
Excited and scared. My Japanese is only N3.
N3 is a good start! The classes are in English?
Yes, the program is in English. Robotics.
Robotics! Ooh, you'll build robots!
Haha, maybe. My parents cried when I told them.
Happy tears?
Mostly. Mom is worried about the cold.
Sendai winters are cold! You need a real coat.
I'll buy one there. Cheaper.
Smart. What about housing?
The university dorm, 30,000 yen a month.
That's not bad at all!
I need to send the documents by 15 January.
Make a list! Passport, certificates, photos...
And a health check. I booked it for 5 January.
You're so organised!
I have to be. I'll miss home, though.
We can still talk every day. I'll be right here.

target: The user won a MEXT scholarship for a master's in robotics, taught in English, at Tohoku University in Sendai, and leaves on 28 March. They are excited and scared; their Japanese is N3. Their parents cried, mostly from happiness, and their mother worries about the cold; the user will buy a coat in Japan. They will live in the university dorm for 30,000 yen a month. The documents are due by 15 January, and a health check is booked for 5 January. The user said they will miss home, and the companion said they can still talk every day.

messages.text: work was terrible today
...What happened?
My client changed the design for the fourth time.
The fourth? Tch.
And the deadline is still Friday.
Did you tell your boss?
Yes, Mr. Tuan said just do it.
Of course he did.
I've been working until 10pm all week.
That's not sustainable. You know that.
I know. I'm so tired.
Then today you stop at 8. Non-negotiable.
But the deadline...
Will still be Friday tomorrow. Your sleep won't wait.
Fine. 8pm.
Good. What's left on the design?
The homepage and two product pages.
Homepage tomorrow morning, when you're fresh.
And the product pages Thursday.
See? It fits.
Thanks. I feel a bit better.
Hmph. Of course you do. Now go eat something.

target: The user had a terrible day at work: their client changed the design for the fourth time and the deadline is still Friday. Their boss, Mr. Tuan, told them to do it anyway, and the user has worked until 10pm all week and feels very tired. The companion insisted they stop at 8pm today. The user will do the homepage tomorrow morning and the two product pages on Thursday, and said they felt a bit better.

messages.text: I want to adopt a dog.
Mm. That's a big step.
There's a shelter in Gia Lam with a 2-year-old mixed breed.
What's the dog like?
Her name is Mây. She's shy but gentle.
Shy dogs need patience.
I work from home 3 days a week.
And the other two?
My roommate Phong said he can walk her.
Did he really agree, or was he being polite?
Haha, he really agreed. He grew up with dogs.
Then that sounds possible.
The adoption fee is 500k, with vaccines done.
That's fair.
My landlord allows pets under 15 kg.
How heavy is Mây?
11 kg.
Then the rules are on your side.
I'm visiting her on Saturday at 10.
Go slowly with her. Let her come to you.

target: The user wants to adopt Mây, a shy but gentle 2-year-old mixed-breed dog weighing 11 kg, from a shelter in Gia Lam. The adoption fee is 500k with vaccines done, and their landlord allows pets under 15 kg. The user works from home 3 days a week, and their roommate Phong, who grew up with dogs, agreed to walk her on the other days. The user will visit Mây on Saturday at 10, and the companion advised letting her come to them slowly.

messages.text: I'm learning to make phở from my mom's recipe.
Ehh! The real family recipe?!
Yes! She wrote it down for me finally.
What's the secret?
Charred ginger and onion. And 8 hours of simmering.
Eight hours?! That's dedication!
I started at 6am today.
So it's done at 2pm?
Yes, then I add the spices for the last hour.
Which spices?
Star anise, cinnamon, cloves, and cardamom.
Ooh, the smell must be amazing!
My whole building smells like phở now lol
Your neighbors must be so jealous!
The lady next door already asked for a bowl.
Hehe, you're famous now!
I made 3 kg of beef bones' worth, enough for 10 bowls.
Ten bowls! A phở party!
I'm inviting my cousins on Sunday.
Perfect! Tell me how they rate it!

target: The user is learning to make phở from their mother's written recipe: charred ginger and onion, 8 hours of simmering from 6am, and star anise, cinnamon, cloves and cardamom added in the last hour. The building smells of phở, and the neighbor next door asked for a bowl. The user used 3 kg of beef bones, enough for 10 bowls, and is inviting their cousins on Sunday.

previous: The user applied for a frontend developer job at a startup called Lumi. They were nervous about the first interview on Thursday and practised talking about their React weather app.

messages.text: The interview went well!
Ehh?! Tell me everything!
They asked about my React project for 20 minutes.
The weather app? Ooh!
Yes. The second round is next Tuesday.
Another round! Who's in it?
The CTO, Ms. Ha.
You'll be great!

target: The user applied for a frontend developer job at a startup called Lumi, and their first interview went well; the interviewers asked about their React weather app for 20 minutes. The second round is next Tuesday with the CTO, Ms. Ha.

previous: The user's cat Bơ had a vet visit for his vaccine, which cost 350k. He was fine afterwards.

messages.text: Bơ ate one of my socks.
Oh no... is he okay?
The vet said it should pass. We have to watch him for 2 days.
Poor Bơ... and poor you.
He's acting totally normal, though.
That's a good sign.
I'm hiding all my socks now.
Mm. A wise rule for the house.

target: The user's cat Bơ had his vaccine at the vet, which cost 350k, and was fine. Later he ate one of the user's socks; the vet said it should pass and that they should watch him for 2 days. Bơ is acting normally, and the user is now hiding their socks.

previous: The user wants to start running again after a knee injury that a doctor cleared in March. They plan to run 3 km on Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings at 6:30.

messages.text: I did the first run this morning.
Hmph. You actually did it?
2.5 km, I walked some of it.
That's fine. That was the plan.
My knee feels okay.
Good. Ice it anyway.
Next run is Wednesday.
I'll be checking.

target: The user plans to run 3 km on Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings at 6:30, after a knee injury that a doctor cleared in March. They did their first run this morning, 2.5 km with some walking, and the knee feels okay; the companion told them to ice it anyway. The next run is on Wednesday.

previous: The user is going to Da Lat next weekend with Trang and Vy. They plan a strawberry farm and the night market, and booked a homestay for 2 nights.

messages.text: Trang can't come to Da Lat anymore.
Oh no! What happened?
Her company called her back for a project.
So it's just you and Vy?
Yes. We changed the homestay to a smaller room, 600k a night.
Cheaper, at least! Still doing the strawberry farm?
Yes! And Vy wants to see the flower gardens too.
Ooh, more photos for me!

target: The user planned a weekend trip to Da Lat with Trang and Vy, with a strawberry farm, the night market and a homestay for 2 nights. Trang can no longer come because her company called her back for a project, so the user and Vy changed to a smaller room for 600k a night. They still plan the strawberry farm, and Vy wants to see the flower gardens.
